english.title: Fail to comply with duty to notify registrar of pre-incorporation changes in required particulars
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were

(A)_[a company]_
(B)_[an officer of a company, namely **(..SPECIFY COMPANY..), who was in default]_

to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied and which had had confirmation of a pre-incorporation change in the required particulars of a proposed PSC, how those particulars had changed and the date on which they changed and, failed, without reasonable excuse and within the required time limits, to give a notice to the registrar of companies for England and Wales stating that change in particulars and the date on which the change had occurred
english.legislation: Contrary to section 790LE and 790LJ of the Companies Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a company OR
an officer of a company to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied and
having had confirmation that there had been a pre-incorporation change in the required particulars of a proposed PSC
without reasonable excuse and
within the required time limit
failed to give notice to the registrar of companies for England and Wales
in accordance with section 790LE of the Act
